summary: Iteration 13 verified everything in the review request against the deployed preview and MongoDB directly. FRONTEND: /methodology renders methodology-note with all three sub-testids (pause, provisional, delivered), no digits, no parent-product / MRD / shadow / reliability-gates mentions; five instrument entries incl. methodology-everyday whose Stated weaknesses lead with 'The desirability pre-test has not been run'; EI entry no longer describes 'banded High / Moderate / Developing' and says the words 'have been withdrawn'. Landing renders it-ends-mark as an <svg> containing a <line stroke='#1C1C18'> that stops at x=300 in a 420-wide viewBox with MONTH ONE / THREE labels — no fill, no percentage, no 'complete' text. All eleven landing testids in strictly increasing y at 1920px (hero-h1 through safety-link). Mobile 390px: it-ends-mark still visible, no horizontal overflow on / or /methodology. Zero console errors. Personality result page 'primary factors' rows correctly show 'at your own middle', globals show 'above/below/at your own middle', and 'The three furthest from your own middle' fallback renders ('None of your factors sits far enough…'). BACKEND: login OK, five completed instrument sessions present, latest session for each instrument returns 200 on /api/v2/assessments/{sid}/result AND /report.pdf, PDFs are byte-identical on repeat. Combined PDF is 200 %PDF, contents lists all FIVE instruments (essential, personality, closeness, eq, Everyday Mirror), header reads 'five instruments read side by side' (not 'of four'), Everyday body section is present, byte-identical on repeat. CRITICAL BUG: the personality choosing block still prints 'At 7 of 10 you sit clearly toward warm.' / '…toward conscientious.' — visible on the deployed result page AND embedded inside the combined PDF text. Root cause verified: /app/backend/choosing.py is correct (re-running _personality() against the stored ui.demo personality result yields the new 'You sit toward stable/forthright…' copy with no 'of 10'), but the narratives collection contains a disp-1.2.0 document written at 2026-09-07T16:39:55Z that still carries the pre-fix 'At 7 of 10…' copy. Because resolved_narrative() is write-once on (session_id, display_version, situation), every subsequent read of that session — including the personality embed inside the combined report — serves that stale snapshot. Same story for db.rendered_pdfs (the disp-1.2.0 combined pdf was rendered at 2026-09-07T16:51:15Z, after the stale narrative was frozen). Fix path: either purge disp-1.2.0 narratives + rendered_pdfs that contain 'of 10' (or all of them, since bytes-identical is the guarantee for delivered docs and these were minted this iteration), or bump DISPLAY_VERSION to disp-1.2.1 so a fresh snapshot is written. Do NOT edit choosing.py — the code is correct.

critical_code_review_comments: services/narrative.py write-once policy is correct in spirit but has a foot-gun: if code is deployed AFTER a snapshot was already taken under the current display_version, the fix is invisible forever. Either the DISPLAY_VERSION bump has to be strictly synchronized with the code change, or invalidation-by-content should exist. This iteration's regression is exactly this failure mode.
The it-ends-mark SVG uses stroke only (no fill) and stops at x=300 of viewBox 420 — reads as a terminated line, not a progress bar. Good.
Methodology.js entries and the METHOD_NOTE section are complete; five entries incl. Everyday, note is nine paragraphs with no digits/banned words.

rca of the issue: Snapshot ordering: services/narrative.py.resolved_narrative() writes the resolved choosing block once per (session_id, DISPLAY_VERSION, situation) via $setOnInsert. DISPLAY_VERSION was bumped to disp-1.2.0 for iteration 13. However, the first read of the ui.demo personality result under disp-1.2.0 fired at 2026-09-07T16:39:55Z — before the backend/choosing.py code change had taken effect (or before the backend was reloaded with it) — so the frozen snapshot captured the old 'At 7 of 10 you sit clearly toward warm' body. The write-once guarantee then serves that stale document to every later reader, including the combined PDF renderer (which pulls the personality choosing block and got its own disp-1.2.0 rendered_pdfs entry at 16:51:15Z carrying the same leak). Reproduction: (1) login as ui.demo, (2) GET /api/v2/assessments/c92ddeea-b330-4ae2-9d80-121e888d7312/result → response.choosing.points[0].body starts with 'At 7 of 10 you sit clearly toward warm'; (3) direct MongoDB check confirms db.narratives has display_version='disp-1.2.0' with the same string; (4) importing choosing._personality() and re-running against the same stored result yields the correct new copy — proving the code is right and only the snapshot is wrong. Mitigation: bump DISPLAY_VERSION to disp-1.2.1 or targeted delete of the affected disp-1.2.0 documents, then re-hit the endpoints so a fresh snapshot is minted.
